mjr. purchase order: ship mined ore shubin_rg_discovery_shipmining_nyx_quantanium shubin interstellar ship mining standing pickup: generated from nyx, stanton and nyx +3 pool posting: purchase order
location: [system] 

terms*: 
shubin interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. we appreciate your help in this matter.

[hint_location] many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.

reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [hint_tool].

once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [destination].
